h1: Laax ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Laax sits in the Surselva valley in Grisons, and what the resort publishes about itself is almost entirely freestyle: five snow parks holding over 90 obstacles, a Pro Kicker Line of four Olympic-sized kickers strung over a full kilometre of piste, and a superpipe in Snowpark NoName that runs 220 metres long, 22 metres wide and 7 metres high - which the operator calls the largest in Europe.
stayOverview: Three villages share the mountain: Laax Murschetg at the valley base by the cable cars, the old village of Laax below it, and Flims and Falera on either side of the same lift network.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Murschetg is the one to pick if you want to walk to the first lift.
rentalCars: Laax is about an hour from Chur on the Surselva road, with Zurich airport around two hours away.

season.note: The operator opens the season over the weekend of 28 and 29 November 2026, holds a season-pass day on 4 December, and starts daily winter sports operations on 5 December. No closing date is published.

longestRun.unannounced: The operator gives the 1,100 to 3,018 m range, 216 km of slopes and 30 cable car facilities, and names its five snow parks and the world's largest halfpipe, but publishes no run lengths and names no longest run.

dayPass.unannounced: The operator states that day, multi-day and afternoon tickets are dynamically priced, and its ticket page still carries 2025/26 figures, so no fixed 2026/27 day rate is published.
